112	/** 暴力定标：fresh(seed) 消耗 N 次后 StreamHash == want（上限 hi） */
113	function calibrateN(seed: number, want: string, hi = 3_000_000): number {
114	  const ur = new UnifiedRandom(seed);
115	  for (let n = 0; n <= hi; n++) {
116	    if (streamHashOf(ur) === want) return n;
117	    (ur as unknown as { internalSample: () => number }).internalSample();
118	  }
119	  return -1;
120	}

128	    else if (v && typeof v === 'object') c[k] = { ...(v as Record<string, unknown>) };

26			lock (_lock)

31				}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Terraria.ID;

public class SetFactory
{
	protected int _size;

	private readonly Queue<int[]> _intBufferCache = new Queue<int[]>();

	private readonly Queue<ushort[]> _ushortBufferCache = new Queue<ushort[]>();

	private readonly Queue<bool[]> _boolBufferCache = new Queue<bool[]>();

	private readonly Queue<float[]> _floatBufferCache = new Queue<float[]>();

	private object _queueLock = new object();

	public SetFactory(int size)
	{
		if (size == 0)
		{
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("size cannot be 0, the intializer for Count must run first");
		}
		_size = size;
	}

	protected bool[] GetBoolBuffer()
	{
		lock (_queueLock)
		{
			if (_boolBufferCache.Count == 0)
			{
				return new bool[_size];
			}
			return _boolBufferCache.Dequeue();
		}
	}

	protected int[] GetIntBuffer()
	{
		lock (_queueLock)
		{
			if (_intBufferCache.Count == 0)
			{
				return new int[_size];
			}
			return _intBufferCache.Dequeue();
		}
	}

	protected ushort[] GetUshortBuffer()
	{
		lock (_queueLock)
		{
			if (_ushortBufferCache.Count == 0)
			{
				return new ushort[_size];
			}
			return _ushortBufferCache.Dequeue();
		}
	}

	protected float[] GetFloatBuffer()
	{
		lock (_queueLock)
		{
			if (_floatBufferCache.Count == 0)
			{
				return new float[_size];
			}
			return _floatBufferCache.Dequeue();
		}
	}

	public void Recycle<T>(T[] buffer)
	{
		lock (_queueLock)
		{
			if (typeof(T).Equals(typeof(bool)))
			{
				_boolBufferCache.Enqueue((bool[])(object)buffer);
			}
			else if (typeof(T).Equals(typeof(int)))
			{
				_intBufferCache.Enqueue((int[])(object)buffer);
			}
		}
	}

274	    let tooClose = false;
275	    for (let ti = x - 150; ti < x + 150 && !tooClose; ti += 10) {
276	      if (ti <= 0 || ti > st.w - 1) continue;
277	      for (let tj = y - 150; tj < y + 150; tj += 10) {

291	        if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy)) continue;
292	        const i = st.idx(x + dx, y + dy);
293	        if (!st.flags[i]) continue;

309	      { const f2 = (globalThis as { __swHvLog?: (s: string, n?: number) => void }).__swHvLog; if (f2) f2(`TUN ${Math.floor(px)},${Math.floor(py)}`, undefined); }
310	      [ex, ey] = hiveTunnel(st, rng, gs, Math.floor(px), Math.floor(py));

323	      for (let ix = fx0; ix < fx1; ix++) {

325	          const ii = st.idx(ix, iy);

335	        && !(st.flags[st.idx(hx, ey)] && st.flags[st.idx(hx, ey + 1)]

337	        hx += dir;
338	      }
339	      if (Math.abs(hx - ex) > 50) continue;
340	      const x2 = hx + dir;

342	      let notInHive = false;
343	      for (let ix = x2 - 1; ix <= x2 + 2; ix++) {
344	        for (let iy = ey - 1; iy <= ey + 2; iy++) {
345	          if (ix < 10 || ix > st.w - 10) { notInHive = true; break; }
346	          if (st.flags[st.idx(ix, iy)] && st.type[st.idx(ix, iy)] !== HIVE) { notInHive = true; break; }

348	        if (notInHive) break;

350	      if (!notInHive) {

354	    }
355	    // 幼虫托台(BOSS 房):CreateStandForLarva(HiveBiome.cs:394)——登记 Clamp(5,max-5)

357	    //   曾把搭台也推迟到 BeeLarva pass（cs:21018）——原版该 pass 会重建同款托台

359	    //   读到错状态。幼虫 tile 231 仍由 BeeLarva pass 放置
360	    const lx = Math.floor(px), ly = Math.floor(py);
361	    gs.larvaX.push(Math.max(5, Math.min(st.w - 5, lx)));
362	    gs.larvaY.push(Math.max(5, Math.min(st.h - 5, ly)));
363	    for (let ix = lx - 1; ix <= lx + 1 && ix > 0 && ix < st.w; ix++) {
364	      for (let iy = ly - 2; iy <= ly + 1 && iy > 0 && iy < st.h; iy++) {
365	        if (!st.inBounds(ix, iy)) continue;

369	        } else {

371	        }
372	      }
373	    }
374	    // ★AddProtectedStructure(±50, padding 5)(HiveBiome.cs:124,Place 返回**前**):
375	    //   原版主巢先注册保护区,驱动(WorldGen.cs:16036-16053)才掷蜂蜜斑——斑与本巢
376	    //   互斥。曾把注册放在斑循环之后 → 斑可落主巢正中。
377	    //   矩形语义:Rectangle(x-50, y-50, 100, 100) 半开区间 + Inflate(5) → 存 x±55/y±55
378	    //   （旧局部近似 {x-45..x+55} 左上偏 10 格,已按原版校正）
379	    addProtectedStructure(gs, { x0: x - 50, y0: y - 50, x1: x + 50, y1: y + 50 }, 5);
380	    // ★cs:16036-16053:主巢落成后是"蜂蜜斑"(HoneyPatchBiome)而非卫星巢——
381	    //   目标数 Next(5)、预算 10000、每次先掷半径 NextDouble*60+30 再掷角度
382	    //   NextDouble*2π,y 无压缩;落点横向 50 边距内或放置失败则不计
383	    const patches = rng.int(0, 4);
384	    let done = 0, budget = 10000;
385	    while (done < patches && budget > 0) {
386	      const rad = rng.next() * 60 + 30;
387	      const ang = rng.next() * 6.2831854820251465;
388	      const hx = Math.trunc(Math.cos(ang) * rad) + x;
389	      const hy = Math.trunc(Math.sin(ang) * rad) + y;
390	      budget--;
391	      hvN('honey_try');
392	      if (hx > 50 && hx < st.w - 50 && placeHoneyPatch(st, rng, gs, hx, hy)) { hvN('honey_ok'); done++; }
393	    }
394	    placed++;
395	  }

398	// ===================== 蜘蛛巢（1456 SpiderCaves L17455 + Spread.Spider L3653 1:1） =====================
399	const POT = TILE_BY_KEY['pot']!;
400	const DECO165 = TILE_BY_KEY['v_165_cave_decos']!;
401	const DECO187 = TILE_BY_KEY['v_187_decos_3x2_group_2']!;
402	const SMALL185 = TILE_BY_KEY['v_185_small_decos']!;
403	const MUSHROOM_GRASS = TILE_BY_KEY['v_70_mushroom_grass_block']!;
404	const MAX_TILE_COUNT = 3500; // 原版 maxTileCount（countTiles 硬顶）
405	/** 原版 pass 63 时洞穴尚无自然墙（CaveWalls pass 67 才刷）。我方 TerrainPass 预填了
406	 *  墙 1/2——此处按原版时序语义视作"无墙"（可穿行、可覆写为 62） */
407	const treatAsNoWall = (wl: number) => wl === 0 || wl === 1 || wl === 2;
408	
409	/** 原版 SolidTile 语义：active(flags) + tileSolid。生成期幽灵 tile（有 type 无 flags）不算实心。
410	 *  tileSolid 走 GenSolid：蜂巢/蜂蜜斑时点 484 滚动仙人掌（cs:12537）与 659 以太石块
411	 *  （cs:11500）已翻非实心,原版 Modifiers.IsSolid 读可变 tileSolid 同样不认 */
412	function solidTile(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
413	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
414	  const i = st.idx(x, y);
415	  if (!st.flags[i]) return false;
416	  return genSolidType(st.type[i]);
417	}
418	
419	/** countTiles（L9493）1:1：洪泛计数非实心格，硬顶 3500；
420	 *  触界/遇墙 → 直接判满（reject）；shroom 按访问次数计（蘑菇草地邻接>1 即拒绝） */
421	function countTiles(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): { count: number; shroom: number } {
422	  let count = 0, shroom = 0;
423	  const seen = new Set<number>();
424	  const stack: Array<[number, number]> = [];
425	  if (!(x <= 1 || x >= st.w - 1 || y <= 1 || y >= st.h - 1)) stack.push([x, y]);
426	  while (stack.length) {
427	    if (count >= MAX_TILE_COUNT) break;
428	    const [cx, cy] = stack.pop()!;
429	    if (cx <= 1 || cx >= st.w - 1 || cy <= 1 || cy >= st.h - 1) return { count: MAX_TILE_COUNT, shroom };
430	    const k = cx * 100000 + cy;
431	    if (seen.has(k)) continue;
432	    const i = st.idx(cx, cy);
433	    if (!treatAsNoWall(st.wall[i])) return { count: MAX_TILE_COUNT, shroom };
434	    seen.add(k);
435	    if (st.flags[i] && st.type[i] === MUSHROOM_GRASS) shroom++;
436	    if (!solidTile(st, cx, cy)) {
437	      count++;
438	      stack.push([cx - 1, cy], [cx + 1, cy], [cx, cy - 1], [cx, cy + 1]);
439	    }
440	  }
441	  return { count, shroom };
442	}

444	/** PlacePot（cs:54099-54105）1:1：2×2（y-1..y 行），随机 3 变体在 X 轴、style 在 Y 轴；
445	 *  占用格须空、脚下须 nactive && !halfBrick && slope==0 && tileSolid（原版四连门） */
446	function placePot(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number, style: number): boolean {
447	  for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
448	    for (let l = -1; l < 1; l++) {
449	      if (!st.inBounds(x + k, y + l) || st.flags[st.idx(x + k, y + l)]) return false;
450	    }
451	    const gi = st.idx(x + k, y + 1);
452	    if (!st.flags[gi] || st.half[gi] || st.slope[gi] !== 0) return false;
453	    if (!solidTile(st, x + k, y + 1)) return false;
454	  }
455	  const variant = rng.int(0, 2) * 36; // 原版仅在放置成功时消费 Next(3)
456	  for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
457	    for (let l = -1; l < 1; l++) {
458	      st.setTileSilent(x + k, y + l, POT, k * 18 + variant, (l + 1) * 18 + style * 36);
459	    }
460	  }
461	  return true;
462	}

464	/** PlaceTight(spiders:true)（L?）1:1：垂挂蛛网 165（1×2，fx=108+variation*18）；
465	 *  消耗 Next(2)+Next(3)（与原版参数求值顺序一致） */
466	function placeTightWebs(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): boolean {
467	  rng.int(0, 1); // preferSmall
468	  const variation = rng.int(0, 2);
469	  if (!solidTile(st, x, y - 1)) return false;
470	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) return false;
471	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y + 1) || st.flags[st.idx(x, y + 1)]) return false;
472	  const fx = 108 + variation * 18;
473	  st.setTileSilent(x, y, DECO165, fx, 0);
474	  st.setTileSilent(x, y + 1, DECO165, fx, 18);
475	  return true;
476	}

478	/** PlaceTile(187, style) 近似：3×2 覆饰，底行=air 格 y、顶行 y-1（fx=style*54 单行，Tiles_187 1890×72 实证） */
479	function placeDeco187(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, style: number): boolean {
480	  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
481	    for (let l = -1; l < 1; l++) {
482	      if (!st.inBounds(x + k, y + l) || st.flags[st.idx(x + k, y + l)]) return false;
483	    }
484	  }
485	  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
486	    for (let l = -1; l < 1; l++) {
487	      st.setTileSilent(x + k, y + l, DECO187, style * 54 + k * 18, (l + 1) * 18);
488	    }
489	  }
490	  return true;
491	}

493	/** PlaceSmallPile（L?）1:1：size0=1×1（fx=style*18）；size1=2×1（fx=style*36，fy=18） */
494	function placeSmallPile(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, pileStyle: number, pileSize: number): boolean {
495	  if (pileSize === 1) {
496	    if (!solidTile(st, x, y + 1) || !solidTile(st, x + 1, y + 1)) return false;
497	    if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) return false;
498	    if (!st.inBounds(x + 1, y) || st.flags[st.idx(x + 1, y)]) return false;
499	    st.setTileSilent(x, y, SMALL185, pileStyle * 36, 18);
500	    st.setTileSilent(x + 1, y, SMALL185, pileStyle * 36 + 18, 18);
501	    return true;
502	  }
503	  if (!solidTile(st, x, y + 1)) return false;
504	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) return false;
505	  st.setTileSilent(x, y, SMALL185, pileStyle * 18, 0);
506	  return true;
507	}

509	/** Spread.Spider（L3653）1:1：波前 BFS 逐层扩散。
510	 *  每格：地狱线/地表线随机带（Next(5)×2）双重拦截；实心或已有墙 → 实心且无墙时背面刷 62 后止步；
511	 *  空格无墙 → 刷 62+清液体+内饰（地面 1/3：1/15 蛛网宝箱(939/箱型15)否则蛛网罐 style19-20；
512	 *  天花板 1/3 垂网 165；否则地面放覆饰 187 style9-13 + 1/3 小堆 185×2） */
513	function spreadSpider(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink, x: number, y: number): void {
514	  const seen = new Set<number>();
515	  const key = (px: number, py: number) => px * 100000 + py;
516	  let frontier: Array<[number, number]> = [[x, y]];
517	  const DIRS: Array<[number, number]> = [[-1, 0], [1, 0], [0, -1], [0, 1]];
518	  while (frontier.length) {
519	    const layer = frontier;
520	    frontier = [];
521	    for (const [cx, cy] of layer) {
522	      if (cx < 1 || cx >= st.w - 1 || cy < 1 || cy >= st.h - 1) continue;
523	      if (cy >= gs.lavaLine - rng.int(0, 4)) continue; // UnderworldLayer(h-200) - Next(5)
524	      if (cy < gs.worldSurface + rng.int(0, 4)) continue;
525	      seen.add(key(cx, cy));
526	      const i = st.idx(cx, cy);
527	      if (solidTile(st, cx, cy) || !treatAsNoWall(st.wall[i])) {
528	        if (st.flags[i] && treatAsNoWall(st.wall[i])) st.wall[i] = 62;
529	        continue;
530	      }
531	      st.wall[i] = 62;
532	      if (!st.flags[i]) {
533	        st.liquid[i] = 0; st.liquidType[i] = 0;
534	        if (solidTile(st, cx, cy + 1) && rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {
535	          if (rng.int(0, 14) === 0) {
536	            // notNearOtherChests:true(cs:3708 原版实参)——±25×±8 已有 BasicChest 则拒
537	            placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, cx, cy, { style: 15, loot: 'vi_939_web_slinger', notNearOtherChests: true });
538	          } else {
539	            placePot(st, rng, cx, cy, rng.int(19, 20));
540	          }
541	        }
542	        if (!st.flags[i]) {
543	          if (solidTile(st, cx, cy - 1) && rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {
544	            placeTightWebs(st, rng, cx, cy);
545	          } else if (solidTile(st, cx, cy + 1)) {
546	            placeDeco187(st, cx, cy, 9 + rng.int(0, 4));
547	            if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {
548	              if (!st.flags[i]) placeSmallPile(st, cx, cy, 34 + rng.int(0, 3), 1);
549	              if (!st.flags[i]) placeSmallPile(st, cx, cy, 48 + rng.int(0, 5), 0);
550	            }
551	          }
552	        }
553	      }
554	      for (const [dx, dy] of DIRS) {
555	        if (!seen.has(key(cx + dx, cy + dy))) frontier.push([cx + dx, cy + dy]);
556	      }
557	    }
558	  }
559	}

561	/** SpiderCaves pass（L17455）1:1：w*0.005 个巢；采样 x∈[200,w-200) y∈[(ws+rock)/2,h-230)；
562	 *  countTiles 门 500≤空腔<3500（重试上限 w/2，超限放弃该巢；重掷 y 域换 rockLevel+30） */
563	export function runSpiderNestPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
564	  // ★pass 头 tileSolid 翻转（cs:17459 `Main.tileSolid[379] = false`）：泡泡块非实心
565	  //   （countTiles 的 SolidTile 洪泛不再被 379 阻断）。本仓生成期不放置 379,行为无差,
566	  //   存档时间线——原版由 UndergroundJungleTrees 头（cs:17956,本仓缺该 pass,备案）还原。
567	  flipGenSolid([379], false);
568	  const count = Math.floor(st.w * 0.005);
569	  const retryCap = Math.floor(st.w / 2);
570	  const yMin = Math.floor((gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2);
571	  for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
572	    let x = rng.int(200, st.w - 201);
573	    let y = rng.int(yMin, st.h - 231);
574	    let c = countTiles(st, x, y);
575	    let tries = 0;

309	      if (st.flags[st.idx(i, j)] && st.type[st.idx(i, j)] === JUNGLE_GRASS) {
310	        minX = i; flag = true; break;
311	      }
312	    }
313	    if (flag) break;
314	  }
315	  flag = false;
316	  for (let i = st.w - 5; i > 5; i--) {
317	    for (let j = 0; j < bandY; j++) {
318	      if (st.flags[st.idx(i, j)] && st.type[st.idx(i, j)] === JUNGLE_GRASS) {
319	        maxX = i; flag = true; break;
320	      }
321	    }
322	    if (flag) break;
323	  }
324	  for (let l = minX; l <= maxX; l++) {

	public override bool Place(Point origin, StructureMap structures, GenerationProgress progress)
	{
		if (GenBase._tiles[origin.X, origin.Y].active() && WorldGen.SolidTile(origin.X, origin.Y))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (!WorldUtils.Find(origin, Searches.Chain(new Searches.Down(80), new Conditions.IsSolid()), out var result))
		{
			return false;
		}
		result.Y += 2;
		Ref<int> obj = new Ref<int>(0);
		Ref<int> obj2 = new Ref<int>(0);
		Ref<int> obj3 = new Ref<int>(0);
		WorldUtils.Gen(result, new Shapes.Circle(15), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.Scanner(obj), new Modifiers.OnlyTiles(60, 59), new Actions.Scanner(obj2), new Modifiers.OnlyTiles(60), new Actions.Scanner(obj3)));
		if ((double)obj2.Value / (double)obj.Value < 0.75 || obj3.Value < 2)
		{
			return false;
		}
		obj = new Ref<int>(0);
		WorldUtils.Gen(result, new Shapes.Circle(8), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.Scanner(obj)));
		if (obj.Value < 20)
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (!structures.CanPlace(new Rectangle(result.X - 8, result.Y - 8, 16, 16)))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (TooCloseToImportantLocations(result))
		{
			return false;
		}
		WorldUtils.Gen(result, new Shapes.Circle(8), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.RadialDither(0.0, 10.0), new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.SetTile(229, setSelfFrames: true)));
		ShapeData data = new ShapeData();
		WorldUtils.Gen(result, new Shapes.Circle(4, 3), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Blotches(), new Modifiers.IsSolid(), new Actions.ClearTile(frameNeighbors: true), new Modifiers.RectangleMask(-6, 6, 0, 3).Output(data), new Actions.SetLiquid(2)));
		WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(result.X, result.Y + 1), new ModShapes.InnerOutline(data), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.IsEmpty(), new Modifiers.RectangleMask(-6, 6, 1, 3), new Actions.SetTile(59, setSelfFrames: true)));
		WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(result.X, result.Y), new ModShapes.All(data), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Expand(1), new Modifiers.IsBelowHeight(result.Y, inclusive: true), new Modifiers.IsNotSolid(), new Modifiers.NoLiquid(2), new Actions.SetTile(229, setSelfFrames: true)));
		structures.AddProtectedStructure(new Rectangle(result.X - 8, result.Y - 8, 16, 16));
		return true;
	}

	private static bool TooCloseToImportantLocations(Point origin)

		int x = origin.X;

			return true;
		}

			}
			for (int j = y - num; j < y + num; j += 10)

					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	public class SetTile : GenAction
	{
		private ushort _type;

		private bool _doFraming;

		private bool _doNeighborFraming;

		private bool _clearTile;

		public SetTile(ushort type, bool setSelfFrames = false, bool setNeighborFrames = true, bool clearTile = true)
		{
			_type = type;
			_doFraming = setSelfFrames;
			_doNeighborFraming = setNeighborFrames;
			_clearTile = clearTile;
		}

		public override bool Apply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args)
		{
			Tile tile = GenBase._tiles[x, y];
			if (_clearTile)
			{
				tile.Clear(~(TileDataType.Wiring | TileDataType.Actuator));
			}
			tile.type = _type;
			tile.active(active: true);
			if (_doFraming)
			{
				WorldUtils.TileFrame(x, y, _doNeighborFraming);
			}
			return UnitApply(origin, x, y, args);
		}
	}

	public class SetWall : GenAction
	{
		private ushort _type;

		private bool _doFraming;

		private bool _doNeighborFraming;

		private bool _clearTile;

		public SetWall(ushort type, bool setSelfFrames = false, bool setNeighborFrames = true, bool clearTile = true)
		{

	{

		{
			return new GenPassResult
			{
				Name = pass.Name,
				Skipped = true
			};

		Stopwatch stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();

		_progress.Start(pass.Weight);

		{
			_controller.ReportException("Exception in Pass: " + pass.Name, ex);
		}
		_progress.End();
		return new GenPassResult
		{
			Name = pass.Name,
			DurationMs = (int)stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds,

using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;

namespace Terraria.WorldBuilding;

public abstract class GenAction : GenBase
{
	public GenAction NextAction;

	public ShapeData OutputData;

	private bool _returnFalseOnFailure = true;

	public abstract bool Apply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args);

	protected bool UnitApply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args)
	{
		if (OutputData != null)
		{
			OutputData.Add(x - origin.X, y - origin.Y);
		}
		if (NextAction != null)
		{
			return NextAction.Apply(origin, x, y, args);
		}
		return true;
	}

	public GenAction IgnoreFailures()
	{
		_returnFalseOnFailure = false;
		return this;
	}

	protected bool Fail()
	{
		return !_returnFalseOnFailure;
	}

	public GenAction Output(ShapeData data)
	{
		OutputData = data;
		return this;
	}
}

	public class TileScanner : GenAction
	{
		private ushort[] _tileIds;

		public TileScanner(params ushort[] tiles)
		{
			_tileIds = tiles;
			_tileCounts = new Dictionary<ushort, int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < tiles.Length; i++)
			{
				_tileCounts[_tileIds[i]] = 0;
			}
		}

		public override bool Apply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args)
		{

			if (tile.active() && _tileCounts.ContainsKey(tile.type))

			}
			return UnitApply(origin, x, y, args);

/** 蜂蜜坠落块(HiveBiome.cs:206/214):4×4 蜂壳封 2×2 蜜 + 向外砸出凹槽 */
function blockedHoneyCube(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): void {
  for (let ix = x - 1; ix <= x + 2; ix++) {
    for (let iy = y - 1; iy <= y + 2; iy++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(ix, iy)) continue;
      const i = st.idx(ix, iy);
      if (ix >= x && ix <= x + 1 && iy >= y && iy <= y + 1) {
        st.type[i] = 0; st.flags[i] = 0;
        st.liquid[i] = 255; st.liquidType[i] = 3;
      } else {
        st.type[i] = HIVE; st.flags[i] = 1;
      }
    }
  }
}

    }
}
